title: Post-Surgical
Rehabilitation
hero.text: For patients recovering from surgery, to restore mobility, rebuild strength and support a safe return to everyday activities.

overview: Postsurgical rehabilitation is a guided recovery pathway designed to help patients regain strength, mobility and independence after an operation. It bridges the gap between the surgical procedure and a safe return to daily life, ensuring healing happens in a controlled, progressive and functional way.

blocks.text: Post-surgical rehabilitation is a structured recovery programme that begins after a major operation. Its purpose is to help the body as it heals, rebuild function and help patients adapt safely as they return to daily to everyday activities.

Surgery is often essential for conditions affecting the joints, bones, muscles and internal organs. A well-designed rehabilitation programme afterwards can support healing, restore movement and strength, and reduce the risk of complications.
Our post-surgical rehabilitation programme supports recovery after a range of procedures, including:

items: **Neurological and spinal surgery** - including disc repair, spinal fusion, disc replacement and brain surgery
**Orthopaedic surgery** -including joint, bone, and muscle repair and replacement
**Gynaecological and obstetric surgery** - including hysterectomy, postnatal recovery and gynaecological repairs
**Thoracic surgery** - operations involving internal organs such as the heart, lungs and liver
**Breast surgery** - procedures to treat cysts and other conditions
**Urological surgery** - including procedures involving the prostate and bladder
